summary: Iteration 9 - verified 3 new features end-to-end. Backend pytest 6/6 passed (test_iter9_loan_photo_scope.py): (1) Inventory loan history: GET /api/inventory returns outstanding=2 & total=6 after approve, stock 6->4; history endpoint returns entries with requester_name/role/kelas/nisn/status/purpose/return_date/created_at; siswa forbidden (403); Dikembalikan restores stock=6 outstanding=0. (2) POST /api/attendance/scan accepts optional photo URL and persists on record; GET /api/attendance shows the photo; scan without photo still 200. (3) Teacher scope: guru POST /classes stores created_by; guru CAN PATCH/DELETE own class & POST /assignments & /quizzes; on class NOT owned/homeroom, PATCH/DELETE/assignments/quizzes all return 403; super_admin bypasses. critical_code_review_comments: AssignmentIn/QuizIn still require 'kelas' as a separate string alongside 'class_id' - redundant since class_id already identifies the class; consider deriving kelas from the class doc server-side.
server.py is now ~1770 lines - continue to consider splitting into routers (auth/users/inventory/attendance/classes/borrow) for maintainability.
PATCH /api/borrow/{bid} still uses ?status= query param instead of a Pydantic body - inconsistent REST style.
seed_data_creation: TEST_iter9_item (auto-deleted); TEST_iter9_guru_owned_<ts>, TEST_iter9_admin_owned_<ts>, TEST_iter9_admin_full_<ts> classes created & deleted in tests; one attendance record with photo=https://example.com/proof_iter9.jpg persists for siswa.demo (harmless, is_demo=true).
